xor-latest.description: Recommended - XOR text alias; boolean, choice and score questions over a 131,072-token window. A request with a value question, an image or audio goes to xor-omni when no model was chosen (decide.capableModel)

xor-omni.description: XOR multimodal alias; boolean, choice, score and value questions over a 32,768-token window, plus one image and up to 30 seconds of audio

xor-1.1.description: Name served by the deprecated /v1/systemone route; superseded by xor-latest and xor-omni. Still sent as given when you name it - the endpoint decides whether it accepts it

setup.description: API key for your XOR endpoint
instructions: 1. Reach an XOR deployment, or use a LiteLLM proxy with a pass-through route to one
2. Set XOR_BASE_URL to its origin (NeuroLink calls <XOR_BASE_URL>/v1/decisions)
3. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} to the key it accepts (on LiteLLM, a virtual key whose team allows xor-latest, and xor-omni for media)

rosterVerified.method: Probed POST <origin>/v1/decisions through a LiteLLM gateway with both aliases. xor-latest read a needle at 120,076 input tokens and refused 200,076 as longer than its 131,072-token context; xor-omni refused past 32,768. 128 questions were answered and 256 refused; a choice took 64 options (63 plus unknown; 64 plus unknown crashed with a 500); a score took 10 levels and 11 were refused by the gateway. value answered int, float and pattern-bound strings on xor-omni, and on xor-latest through the gateway's fallback to xor-omni. One image was read (a second was refused with 422) at a fixed ~600 tokens whatever its resolution. Audio as {data, format} was heard in WAV, FLAC, Ogg, Opus and MP3 (an English speech clip identified at 0.9999 in each) at ~25 tokens a second and cut at 30 seconds, keeping the start; M4A/AAC decoded to nothing. A video, sent as a data URL or as {data, format}, returned the same answer as garbage bytes, so the gateway drops it. The body cap was 24 MiB. A malformed image or audio clip and an over-long state returned 502 wrapping the backend's 400
